Cloud Modernization & Automation: Drive initiatives focused on cloud optimization, workload migrations, automation, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and continuous improvement of cloud services tailored to manufacturing and energy demands. Governance & Cost Management: Implement robust FinOps practices to monitor cloud consumption, optimize spending, and enforce resource governance across Azure and GCP. Reliability & Resilience: Own availability, capacity planning, backup/recovery strategies, business continuity, and major incident resolution for all cloud-hosted energy platforms. Incident, Problem & Change Management: Direct experience establishing and running operational frameworks (ITIL-based) for major incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), proactive problem management, and change governance to minimize deployment risk. Monitoring, Observability & Telemetry: Hands-on oversight of enterprise monitoring, logging, and performance tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) to ensure early detection and proactive remediation of infrastructure bottlenecks. Patch Management & Lifecycle Hygiene: Drive systematic, automated patching schedules, vulnerability remediation cycles, and hardware/software end-of-life tracking across cloud and hybrid environments. Blended-Model Operations: Experience managing a matrixed operations model spanning internal engineering teams, third-party managed service providers (MSPs), and global vendor support lines to maintain accountability and fast mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR). Infrastructure changes, deployments, and patching cycles are automated, repeatable, and cause minimal business disruption. Cross-functional teams and external partners operate with clear lines of accountability and strong collaboration. Cloud Expertise: Deep hands-on experience and architecture knowledge in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) enterprise environments (certifications preferred). Enterprise ERP Knowledge: Proven experience managing infrastructure, database sizing, high availability, and disaster recovery specifically for SAP S/4HANA or complex enterprise ERP systems hosted in the cloud. Technical Breadth: Strong background in compute, virtualization, Linux/Windows operating systems, enterprise storage, networking, backup/recovery, and infrastructure automation (e.g., Terraform, Ansible). Vendor & Financial Management: Demonstrated experience managing cloud vendor relationships, managed service providers (MSPs), and cloud budgeting/FinOps. Industry Context: Familiarity with automotive, energy, manufacturing, or supply chain technology landscapes is a strong plus. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
